notes.public_op:access_control.authenticate_re: Consumed by trust-boundary wiring and never exposed as a standalone endpoint.

notes.public_op:chatgpt_interaction.prepare_ch: External A16 capability proposal.prepare: the plugin obtains a reviewable proposal bound to an exact target revision; it persists nothing but the prepared effect reservation.
notes.public_op:chatgpt_interaction.confirm_ch: External A16 capability effect.confirm: the A02 explicit confirmation of one prepared proposal; a consequential domain capability proceeds only against the reservation this operation authorizes.
notes.public_op:chatgpt_interaction.report_com: External A16 capability effect.outcome: separate Card, source-custody, and local-synchronization outcomes of one confirmed effect (A02 rule 8).
